about_the_game:
He just wants to paint… and you're his favorite color.

Wake up as Tommy, a young boy who hears strange noises in the middle of the night. With your flashlight in hand, explore your house, search for keys, and uncover why every shadow suddenly feels alive.

Inkzy, the once-beloved amusement park clown, has vanished from the spotlight after horrifying rumors surfaced... whispers of missing children, red-painted rides, and laughter that never ends.

You’re not alone.

🕹 Gameplay Highlights:

  • 🔦 Use limited flashlights to scare off Inkzy... run out, and it's game over

  • 🎈 Pop floating balloons before they track you down

  • 💡 Stop a creeping shadow with your lamp before it reaches you

  • 🗝 Search drawers for keys, disturbing notes, and chilling recordings

  • 🔪 Avoid traps, hidden threats, and clown jumpscares

  • 🧩 Solve puzzles in tense first-person moments while being hunted

  • 🏃‍♂️ Hide in closets, outrun chase sequences, and survive mashing contests

Section by section, reality twists. The world feels... off. Rooms shift, colors change, and the line between nightmare and memory fades.

short_description: Wake up as Tommy, a kid trapped in his house with a killer clown. Find keys, escape traps, and survive Inkzy’s twisted games using flashlights, hiding spots, and quick thinking. He’s painting again...and red is his favorite color.
